lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular clusters are arranged in an irregular grid composed of approximately five discernible vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, creating visible anchor nodes that form a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and defined shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Echeneidae (remora) individuals, including one positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin and several others visible near the posterior flank and caudal region.
